Title: Public preview: Azure Search Basic tier

Body.Content: We are excited to announce the new, lower-cost Basic tier of Azure Search! Filling the gap between the Free and Standard tiers, the Basic tier can search up to 1 million documents (or 2 GB of data) while delivering an SLA to give a production-quality search experience. During the public preview, we are offering the Basic tier at a 50 percent discount. Refer to the pricing page for additional details, or create your own Basic Azure Search service. Read the announcement or read this article to learn more about the capabilities of Azure Search.
Body.Markdown:
We are excited to announce the new, lower-cost Basic tier of Azure Search! Filling the gap between the Free and Standard tiers, the Basic tier can search up to 1 million documents (or 2 GB of data) while delivering an SLA to give a production-quality search experience.

During the public preview, we are offering the Basic tier at a 50 percent discount. Refer to the pricing page for additional details, or create your own Basic Azure Search service .

Read the announcement or read this article to learn more about the capabilities of Azure Search.
